title: HSBar 솔로 #067 · 누비안부티빌더 · Korean najeon mother-of-pearl lacquer · 철봉(벽-벽) 결박 · a deep red lip
prompt:
Image format: a vertical portrait-orientation photograph, 2:3 aspect ratio, taller than it is wide.

A full-body photograph in a medieval stone dungeon torture chamber with rough-cut stone block walls on each side of her, a low vaulted stone ceiling, iron torch sconces with flickering flames on the walls, old iron tools hanging on the stone wall, a damp flagstone floor, dark and moody firelight, shot on a medium format camera with an 85mm lens at f/8, a single hard key light raking in from one side, sharp focus from head to toe, realistic photographic grain — a real photograph, not an illustration, not CGI, not a render.

Subject: ONE real adult Italian woman in her early 20s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, warm olive skin, thick strongly arched dark brows, a long black liner winging up and out at the outer corner of each eye, soft brown eyeshadow, long lashes, large dark eyes with bright real catchlights, a deep red lip with a quietly weary look, heavy eyelids and a faint tension at the corners of her lips, deep reddish mahogany-brown hair styled in vintage victory rolls framing the face, real living eyes. Long round nails, chrome finish.

Physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. a professional female bodybuilder physique carrying around 230 pounds of dense, hard, fully developed muscle, with the most extreme glute and hip development. Gigantic rounded shoulders with visible separation between the front, side and rear deltoids, thick swollen biceps and triceps with a deep split between them, wide flaring lats, a deeply carved abdomen with sharp obliques, colossal glutes and hips so massively muscular they extend far beyond the shoulders, gigantic quadriceps with a deep outer sweep and a visible teardrop shape above each knee, thick hamstrings, and diamond-shaped calves. The waist is narrow only in contrast to the massive hips and shoulders. Every muscle group is separated by deep grooves and hard edges. Hard and muscular, not soft, not a plus-size body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.

Skin: Real photographic skin — visible pores and fine grain, a smooth taut surface with natural creases and shadow only where the flesh folds, faint stretch marks where the great curves have expanded. No smooth illustration finish, no plastic CG sheen.

Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Korean najeon mother-of-pearl lacquer — glossy black lacquer with shimmering mother-of-pearl vines, wide mother-of-pearl bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense scrollwork filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her body below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line. The painted surface is scuffed and dulled along her hips, calves and forearms, rubbed away in a few worn patches at her elbows, inner thighs and ankles so her skin tone shows through, with flakes of pigment lifting at the edges. Soot smears her cheekbones, forehead and jawline, sweat shines on her temples and her makeup is smudged, black dust streaks her forearms, shins and the backs of her hands, and her bare feet and toes are black with grime.

Restraints: Her wrists wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, each ring hooked directly onto a thick straight round iron bar that spans the full width of the chamber from one stone wall to the other, both ends set deep into the stone blocks, at a height just above her raised hands, the cuffs sitting snug against the metal, her wrists a little wider apart than her shoulders and her arms raised straight up. Her ankles wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, each ring hooked directly onto a second straight round iron bar that spans from wall to wall along the flagstone floor, both ends set deep into the stone blocks, the cuffs sitting snug against the metal, her feet spread about shoulder-width apart.

Pose: standing full height between the supports, facing the camera, her arms raised straight up with her hands hanging limp and loose from the cuffs, fingers softly curled and relaxed, her head tipped very slightly forward, her bare feet spread about shoulder-width apart flat on the flagstones, her whole body sagging a little with fatigue, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.

Footwear: bare feet flat on the flagstones, the soles, toes and tops of her feet streaked with soot and dirt.

Background & Lighting: the dim light catching the painted pattern in sharp glints, carving every fold and curve.
